In [[3962 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Mandalorian Triumph]] period of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], a '''battle''' occurred in the [[Koler system/Legends|Koler system]] on the edge of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] when the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] tracked the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] [[Sanctuary (starship)|''Sanctuary'']] to the [[Star system/Legends|system]] where it had been hidden by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Val Isa/Legends|Val Isa]]. The ''Sanctuary'' had been repurposed as a mobile hospital and Jedi Temple, but as the Mandalorians pushed into the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], Isa hid the ''Sanctuary'' in the Koler system to protect her students.

The fighting claimed Isa's life and destroyed half of the ''Sanctuary'', but she held off the Mandalorians long enough for her students to escape. One of the Mandalorians' [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]] was damaged during the fighting and remained on the wrecked ship, activating every few years for brief periods.
